steps.en: A registered address change is detected
The mention outcome is recorded automatically
steps.why_id: Tidak ada yang mencatat mention outcome.

steps.en: The processing stage is reverted automatically
steps.why_en: Only outside systems can set the stage; OCMS does not.
steps.why_id: Hanya sistem luar yang bisa set stage; OCMS tidak.

steps.en: The notice goes back to the court-application pool
steps.id: Notice kembali ke pool court application
steps.why_en: No such pool exists in the system.
steps.why_id: Pool seperti itu tidak ada di sistem.
